_noTransactionDataComment: true: this instance reads no operator key file and serves no unsigned calldata (/api/approval, /api/sell/quote, /api/mint/* answer 403). Set explicitly here as well as being the default for chain 99801.
_comment: Elysium TESTNET (99801 / 0x185d9), READ-ONLY instance: native HYPE balances for the wallets below. Elysium is an Arbitrum Orbit chain that settles to HyperEVM testnet (998, metadata only). Copy to $HOME/elysium-testnet-data/settings.json (or LP_ELYSIUM_TESTNET_DATA_DIR). No DEX, NPM or other contract is known on this chain, so there is no contracts section and positions stay empty. Native decimals: 18 is NOT independently proven (the docs name the symbol HYPE but state no decimals), so nativeCurrency.decimals is left out: balances are shown raw, labelled 'decimals unverified', and the Wallet page asks you to add the network by hand instead of guessing. Secrets are NEVER written here: a keyed RPC goes in the environment as LP_ELYSIUM_TESTNET_RPC_URL. Mainnet (99901) is disabled, awaiting verification; there is no mainnet example. Verified by: node tools/verify-onchain.js elysium-testnet

chain.name: Elysium Testnet
chain._rpcUrlComment: The public RPC from the Elysium docs (shared by every user). LP_ELYSIUM_TESTNET_RPC_URL in the environment overrides it in that process only and is never shown to a page or logged.
chain._explorerComment: No Blockscout API is configured: the explorer answers automated requests with a bot challenge, so a Blockscout API was not proven (VERIFICATION-elysium.md V4).
chain._nativeCurrencyComment: decimals omitted on purpose: 18 NOT independently proven (VERIFICATION-elysium.md V3). Add "decimals": 18 only once a second source confirms it.

wallets._comment: Public addresses reused from the PulseChain example (the same EOA works on every EVM chain). Edit them to yours.
